reason: Conversation 1 asked the right narrowing questions up front and, once told 'Neff' and 'flashing 0.00', correctly identified the clock lockout and gave concrete button steps that resolved the fault in one turn, with no parts or engineer pushed. Conversation 1's opener was over-broad and partly US/gas-oriented, but its efficiency and successful closure outweigh that.
